outcome: neurodevelopmental outcome at 2 years corrected age
non-optimal composite criterion of neonatal complications
cohort: Preterm infants born between 24+0 and 33+6 weeks of gestation and hospitalized in a neonatal intensive care unit, categorized by their mothers' pre-pregnancy BMI (normal, overweight, obese).
finding: The study found no significant relationship between maternal pre-pregnancy BMI (normal, overweight, obese) and either neurodevelopmental outcomes at 2 years of corrected age or neonatal outcomes in preterm infants.
